# What Delightful builds (first increment, 2 Nov 2026)

**Everything here was generated by `tools/carry.py` from the source repositories and has NEVER been loaded in Horizon.**
Expect kinks. Counts are from each mod's `CARRY-REPORT.md` in `mods/<id>/`.

One content mod, **`delightful`** (`dist/delightful-0.2.0.hmod`), merged from seven MIT-licensed sources. No toggles and no
separate add-on mods (decided 2 Nov 2026): everything is always on.

| Source | Blocks | Items | Source repository |
|---|---|---|---|
| farmersdelight | 53 | 94 | github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight |
| rusticdelight | 44 | 108 | github.com/PhantomWing/RusticDelight |
| expandeddelight | 39 | 61 | github.com/ianm1647/expandeddelight |
| corn_delight | 4 | 21 | github.com/0999312/Corn-Delight (branch 1.21) |
| dumplings_delight | 14 | 32 | github.com/Joshcraft2002/Dumplings-Delight-Rewrapped |
| cratedelight | 43 | 0 | github.com/axperty/cratedelight (branch 26.2-neoforge) |
| storagedelight | 169 | 0 | github.com/axperty/storagedelight (branch 1.21.11-neoforge) |

**Merged total:** 372 blocks, 312 items, 920 recipes. See `mods/delightful/MERGE-REPORT.md`.

### Merging rules

- Every `<source>:name` became `delightful:name`. Two sources with the same name are **one thing**: the first in priority
  (Farmer's Delight, Rustic, Expanded, Corn, Dumplings, Crate, Storage) keeps its model, textures and loot table.
  Merged by name: the beetroot, carrot and potato crates (Farmer's Delight + Crate Delight) and calamari (Rustic + Dumplings).
  **Merged by decision: Chinese cabbage is plain cabbage** (Dumplings' Chinese cabbage, leaf, seeds, crop and crate became
  Farmer's Delight's cabbage, cabbage leaf, cabbage seeds, cabbages and cabbage crate; its recipes now use cabbage).
- **No duplicate recipes:** recipes with the same type, inputs and results are dropped (first source wins). Two
  Dumplings recipes that became identical to Farmer's Delight's after the cabbage merge were removed; alternative recipes for one item (such as seeds from different pepper slices) are kept on purpose.
- Tags of the same name are merged into one. One creative tab ("Delightful"). One English text file.
- **Machine ids:** `delightful:cooking_pot` and `delightful:cutting_board` (public API for add-ons: do not rename).

## Required mods

**Cookpot** (cooking pot, cutting board) and **Roast** (feasts, pies, plate). Without Roast the feast blocks and plate are inert blocks.

## How things map

- **Food items**: a `minecraft:bread` item with the food and consumable components read from the Java food definitions
  (nutrition, saturation, fast eating, effects). Bowl and bottle remainders carried.
- **Blocks**: a vanilla template guessed from the blockstate's properties, with overrides (crops by growth stages, cakes for
  pies, `tall_grass` for double plants, `farmland`, `glazed_terracotta` for facing-only decoration).
- **Cabinets and baskets**: custom chests: `minecraft:barrel` blocks (a 27-slot container with its own menu). The blockstate
  gets the up and down facings a barrel can have.
- **Cooking pot** (`delightful:cooking_pot`, a Cookpot machine): 6 inputs, a container slot, an output, FD's own GUI
  texture, progress bar. **Heated by a lit campfire, soul campfire, furnace, blast furnace or smoker directly below** (or any
  block in the tag `delightful:heat_sources`). All the cooking recipes.
- **Cutting board** (`delightful:cutting_board`, a Cookpot `instant` machine with a screen): put an item in, get the
  results. **No knife needed** (decided). All the cutting recipes.
- **Creative tab** per mod, in the original's order. **Models, textures, sounds, particles, English text** copied.
- **Loot tables** of declared blocks copied (format unchecked against 26.3).
- **Tags** copied.
- **Feasts and pies (needs the Roast mod):** 11 feast blocks and 11 pies are Roast definitions: servings taken with a bowl, pies eaten in
  bites or sliced with a knife (`#c:tools/knife`). Pumpkin pie is one of them, so **Pumpkin Pie Delight is already covered** (Farmer's Delight 1.3 itself
  makes pumpkin pie placeable and sliceable).
- **A generic plate** (`delightful:plate`, Roast display): places **any item** on it and shows it, which gives Display-Delight-style placing for
  every food without a model per food. Craft 3 white terracotta in a row for 3 plates.
- **Wild crops** generate in the world (15 features, rewritten as plain data; **untested**, see UNSUPPORTED.md).

## Rebuilding

```
# clone the source repos into ../src/mods/ (links in docs/SOURCES.md), then:
python3 tools/carry.py --src ../src/mods/FarmersDelight --id farmersdelight --out work/farmersdelight   # and the other six
python3 tools/prune.py work
python3 tools/merge.py          # writes mods/delightful/
python3 tools/package_mods.py   # dist/delightful-0.2.0.hmod
```

## Not built yet

Nothing from the agreed list is missing except Brewin' And Chewin' (removed for now). Storage Delight's cabinets, drawers and
bookshelves are all `minecraft:barrel` blocks (27 slots each, one vanilla menu); the originals' drawer-specific slot counts are
not reproduced.
